description: calendar_server.py exposes get_today and days_until over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) using JSON-RPC over standard input and output.

steps.description: Import FastMCP and create the 'calendar' MCP server instance.
Decorate get_today and days_until with @mcp.tool so FastMCP publishes their names, docstrings, and typed schemas to any connected MCP client.
mcp.run(show_banner=False) runs the server over stdio so a client process can start it and communicate with it.

title: Serving date tools over MCP with FastMCP
